text: {"standards":[{"code":"L.6.4.a","verdict":"taught","reason":"In the Context Clues and Reading Aloud segment and again in Part A, students use the words around an unfamiliar word, such as circled words in the margin, to work out its meaning."},{"code":"RI.6.1","verdict":"taught","reason":"In Part A students record each fact with the sentence that proves it, and the Quick Write requires text evidence, so they cite textual evidence to support what the text says."},{"code":"RI.6.7","verdict":"not-taught","reason":"The lesson is explicitly words only with no pictures or other media, and the teacher note admits RI.6.7 is addressed only lightly, so students never integrate information across different formats."},{"code":"RI.6.9","verdict":"partly","reason":"In Part B groups compare predictions and discuss how the texts emphasize different aspects of Greek life, but they do not compare how each author presents the same events."}],"anchorText":{"verdict":"uses","reason":"The lesson uses all three listed texts in Part A and Part B, and the Outline names no specific pages, leaving paragraph choice to the teacher."}}
